Narcis Knight mushroom ( Tricholoma sulphureum ) Location, Hortus (Haren, Groningen).
Tricholoma sulphureum the sulphur knight. This fungus has a powerful smell that people have described as gassy or sulphurous but I think it smells like rotting hyacinths.
